question: Among female clients who are account owners (OWNER disposition), find the district name (A2) of the one with the earliest birth date, provided that her district’s 1996 unemployment rate (A13) is above the national average and her account is linked to at least one loan with duration over 24 months.

arguments.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_018
FROM client c
JOIN disp d1 ON c.XCL_009 = d1.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON d1.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND d1.XCL_016 = 'OWNER'
  AND d.XCL_029 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_029) FROM district)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
      AND l.XCL_037 > 24
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
LIMIT 1
